name: Columbia (STS-55)
about: Columbia (STS-55) (1993-027A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1993 Apr 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1993 Apr 28), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
